ios_desc: Download from the App Store for seamless installation on your iPhone or iPad. All features supported.
android_desc: Side-load the APK on any Android device for full Immich functionality. Recommended for most Android users.
win_installer_desc: Standard Windows installer with setup wizard — recommended for most users. Includes desktop shortcuts and auto-updates.
win_portable_desc: No-install portable version — run directly from a USB drive or any folder. Settings are saved alongside the executable.
linux_archive_desc: Extract and run on any Linux distribution. No package manager dependencies required. Compatible with all major distros.
ios_instructions_1: Open the App Store on your iPhone or iPad.
ios_instructions_2: Search for "Immich" or tap the link below.
ios_instructions_3: Tap "Get" to download and install the app.
ios_instructions_4: Open the app and connect to your server using your credentials.
android_instructions_1: Download the APK file using the button below.
android_instructions_2: On your device, go to Settings → Security and enable "Install from unknown sources" (you can disable it after installation).
android_instructions_3: Open the downloaded APK file from your Downloads folder or notification.
android_instructions_4: Tap "Install" and wait for the process to complete.
android_instructions_5: Open the installed app and connect to your server.
win_installer_instructions_1: Download the installer (.exe) file using the button below.
win_installer_instructions_2: Double-click the downloaded file to launch the setup wizard.
win_installer_instructions_3: Follow the on-screen instructions — choose your installation directory and preferences.
win_installer_instructions_4: Click "Install" and wait for the process to complete.
win_installer_instructions_5: Launch Immich Desktop from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
win_portable_instructions_1: Download the portable (.exe) file using the button below.
win_portable_instructions_2: Save it to any folder on your computer or USB drive.
win_portable_instructions_3: Double-click the file to run — no installation required.
win_portable_instructions_4: All your settings are saved alongside the executable file.
linux_archive_instructions_1: Download the archive (.zip) using the button below.
linux_archive_instructions_2: Extract the archive to a folder of your choice.
linux_archive_instructions_3: Open a terminal in the extracted folder or double-click the executable.
linux_archive_instructions_4: Run './immich-desktop' in the terminal or launch it from your file manager.
linux_archive_instructions_5: (Optional) Create a desktop shortcut for quick access.
